name: Fire Baptism
overview: The Scriptures reveal that fire baptism is a powerful work of Christ, who baptizes not only with water but with the Holy Spirit and fire, symbolizing purification and divine judgment. John the Baptist foretold this baptism of fire, emphasizing the separating of the righteous from the unrighteous, as the wheat is gathered and the chaff burned with unquenchable fire. Jesus Himself declared His mission to send fire upon the earth, indicating the transformative and purifying presence of the Holy Spirit. Belief and baptism are essential for salvation, empowering believers to be witnesses through the Spirit's coming.
